items.title: International Tea Day!
items.excerpt: Students explored tea traditions from around the world, learning about culture and history through this beloved beverage.
items.body:
Students at Albayan came together to celebrate International Tea Day with a journey through tea traditions from around the world.

From the green tea ceremonies of Japan to the mint tea of Morocco, and from the spiced karak of Qatar to the afternoon teas of England, our students discovered how a simple cup of tea connects cultures across the globe.

The day included tasting sessions, art projects, and storytelling. Grade 5 students created posters showing where different teas come from, while younger students learned about the history of the tea trade.

A huge thank you to all the teachers and students who made this day so special.
items.author: Albayan Reporters

items.title: Grade 5 imagines the future!
items.excerpt: Our Grade 5 students shared their creative visions of what the future might look like in this inspiring project.
items.body:
What will the world look like in 50 years? Our Grade 5 students put their imagination to work and shared their predictions.

From flying cars to underwater cities, and from robots helping with homework to gardens on Mars, the students' visions of the future were full of creativity and hope.

Each student presented their ideas to the class, and many created detailed drawings and models. The best projects will be displayed in the school hall for everyone to enjoy.

We are so proud of our young thinkers!
items.author: Albayan Reporters

items.title: Lexi and Reem learn about honesty and hard work
items.excerpt: Through storytelling, students discovered why honesty and hard work are essential values in everyday life.
items.body:
This month, our students joined Lexi and Reem on a new adventure — learning about the importance of honesty and hard work.

Through stories, role-play, and class discussions, students explored why telling the truth and giving our best effort make us better people. They shared personal examples of times when honesty was hard but rewarding.

The lesson ended with a class promise: to always try our best and to be honest with ourselves and others.
items.author: Albayan Reporters

items.title: Lexi learns about fasting in Ramadan
items.excerpt: A special video feature exploring the meaning and traditions of fasting during the holy month of Ramadan.
items.body: In this special video, Lexi learns about the meaning and traditions of fasting during Ramadan. From the pre-dawn meal (suhoor) to the evening meal (iftar), Lexi discovers what makes this month so special for millions of people around the world.
items.author: Albayan Reporters

items.title: Albayan celebrated World Education Day
items.excerpt: A week full of activities honoring the importance of education and celebrating our learning community.
items.body:
Albayan celebrated World Education Day with a full week of activities honoring the importance of education.

Students wrote letters to their favorite teachers, decorated classrooms with education-themed artwork, and shared what learning means to them. The week ended with a school-wide assembly featuring performances and speeches from students across all grades.

This celebration reminds us all why education matters — and how lucky we are to learn together.
items.author: Albayan Reporters

items.title: Haya Al-hamr writes about World Diabetes Day
items.excerpt: An informative piece raising awareness about diabetes and healthy lifestyle choices for young people.
items.body:
Diabetes affects millions of people worldwide, and understanding the disease can help us support those around us.

In this article, Haya Hamad Al-hamar explains what diabetes is, the difference between Type 1 and Type 2, and why healthy eating and exercise matter so much for young people.

Her advice: stay active, eat balanced meals, drink water, and never be afraid to ask questions about your health.
items.author: Haya Hamad Al-hamar (6A)

items.title: Our students explored the value of kindness
items.excerpt: A school-wide exploration of what kindness means and how small acts can make a big difference.
items.body:
Kindness is more than just a word — it's a way of living. This month, our students explored what kindness means and how small acts can make a big difference.

Classes discussed examples of everyday kindness: helping a friend, saying thank you, listening, and including others. Students then created a 'Kindness Wall' filled with examples and thank-you notes.

Let's keep the kindness going every day.
items.author: Albayan Reporters

items.title: Our students explored the value of cooperation
items.excerpt: Teamwork and cooperation took center stage as students discovered what it means to work together.
items.body:
Working together makes us stronger. This month, our students discovered the value of cooperation through games, projects, and teamwork activities.

Students practiced listening to each other, sharing ideas, and supporting teammates. They learned that cooperation isn't just about being polite — it's about combining our strengths to achieve something great.
items.author: Aisha Abulrahman Almarwani (5C)

items.title: Welcome back to School!!
items.excerpt: A warm welcome to all our returning and new students as a fresh academic year begins at Albayan.
items.body:
Welcome back, Albayan family! We're so excited to start another amazing year of learning, friendship, and discovery.

To our returning students: we missed you! To our new students: welcome — you're now part of our wonderful community.

Let's make this year unforgettable together.
items.author: Albayan Reporters

items.title: Albayan Author - Grade 3 & 4 original stories
items.excerpt: Young authors from Grade 3 and 4 showcased their wonderful original stories in our Albayan Author program.
items.body:
Our Grade 3 and Grade 4 students became published authors this term through the Albayan Author program!

Each student wrote, illustrated, and bound their own original story. The stories covered a wide range of themes — from desert adventures to space exploration, and from friendship to bravery.

You can read all the stories in our Contest page. We are so proud of our young writers!
